say:1:1560103001:1.source_cn: 吱吱！欢迎主人参与南瓜大竞猜！

say:2:1560103002:1.text: Pick a team to support, then sit back and watch the battle unfold once the countdown ends.
say:2:1560103002:1.source_cn: 记得选个你喜欢的队伍，等倒计时结束他们就开打啦！
say:2:1560103002:1.male: Pick a team to support, then sit back and watch the battle unfold once the countdown ends.
say:2:1560103002:1.female: Pick a team to support, then sit back and watch the battle unfold once the countdown ends.

say:3:1560103003:1.text: Even if your team loses, you'll still get 5 Gourd Tokens, but a win will get you way more!
say:3:1560103003:1.source_cn: 输了也有5个南瓜币安慰奖哦，赢了更多！
say:3:1560103003:1.male: Even if your team loses, you'll still get 5 Gourd Tokens, but a win will get you way more!
say:3:1560103003:1.female: Even if your team loses, you'll still get 5 Gourd Tokens, but a win will get you way more!

say:4:1560103004:1.text: Between us, the question's just a distraction. It's the fight that really counts!
say:4:1560103004:1.source_cn: 溜溜告诉你一个秘密，谁赢谁输只看打架结果，跟竞猜问题没...
say:4:1560103004:1.male: Between us, the question's just a distraction. It's the fight that really counts!
say:4:1560103004:1.female: Between us, the question's just a distraction. It's the fight that really counts!

say:5:1560103005:1.text: Pick whichever team catches your eye and enjoy the show! *Squeak*
say:5:1560103005:1.source_cn: 选好队伍，准备看好戏吧，吱！
say:5:1560103005:1.male: Pick whichever team catches your eye and enjoy the show! *Squeak*
say:5:1560103005:1.female: Pick whichever team catches your eye and enjoy the show! *Squeak*
